reason: The Manifest Generator utility has a CSV input mode that runs fully offline on CPU with only boto3 needed.
goal: Install the dependencies for src/ManifestGenerator (boto3 per its requirements.txt) and make manifestgen.py run in CSV input mode. Given a CSV with header file_name,file_size and S3 URL rows, run `./manifestgen.py --prefix=<out>/OUTFILE --num=4 --csv --input-file=<csv>`. It must write OUTFILE-000.json to OUTFILE-003.json, with the entries split across them. No AWS credentials are needed. Put the environment setup in /work/env.sh so that python3 can import boto3.
check: The hidden test generates a CSV of S3 file URLs and sizes, runs the generator for 4 manifests, and checks that the manifest JSON files are valid and together contain every non-empty entry once, with the correct sizes.
